hints.tr: Listeyi `for name, passed in stages:` ile gez: her çiftin iki parçası iki değişkene ayrılır.
hints.en: Loop over the list with `for name, passed in stages:`: the two parts of each pair go into two variables.

hints.tr: `if not passed:` olduğu anda `return name` yaz; `return` döngüyü de bitirir. Döngü biterse hepsi geçmiş demektir.
hints.en: As soon as `if not passed:` holds, write `return name`; `return` also ends the loop. If the loop finishes, all of them passed.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def run_pipeline(stages):
    for name, passed in stages:
        if not passed:
            return name
    return "passed"


print(run_pipeline([("install", True), ("lint", True), ("test", False), ("package", True)]))
print(run_pipeline([("install", True), ("test", True), ("package", True)]))
print(run_pipeline([("install", False), ("test", False)]))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def run_pipeline(stages):
    for name, passed in stages:
        if not passed:
            return name
    return "passed"


print(run_pipeline([("install", True), ("lint", True), ("test", False), ("package", True)]))
print(run_pipeline([("install", True), ("test", True), ("package", True)]))
print(run_pipeline([("install", False), ("test", False)]))
```
